components.description: Schema-driven query builder: condition rows (property, operator, value) joined by one and/or toggle, "+" adds and "−" removes; the value is a filter tree, `query` its string.
components.usage: Use for a user-editable condition over a schema (columns, entity properties, a domain table). Emit the filter as `value` (`{op: "and", nodes: [{property, operator, value}]}`) or read `query`, the canonical string. Grammar: `prop op value` joined by `and`/`or`, parentheses and `not (…)` for groups; ops `= != > >= < <= like !like starts ends matches in not in between`, `= null` / `!= null` for empty; values: numbers, "strings", true/false/null, ISO dates, relative spans `-1w 2d now`. Examples: `age > 30 and sex = "F"`; `created > -1w and (status in ("Open", "Blocked") or owner = @current)`; `mw between 200 and 500`. Prefer `u2-filter-query-input` for a one-line search box; this control for visible criteria rows.

components.description: One-line query box over a schema with completion at the caret (properties, operators, values, and/or); Enter or blur parses the text into the filter tree, `query` is the text.
components.usage: Use for a compact search box over a schema (columns, entity properties, a domain table) where the user types the condition. Emit the filter as `value` (`{op: "and", nodes: [{property, operator, value}]}`) or read `query`, the text. Grammar: `prop op value` joined by `and`/`or`, parentheses and `not (…)` for groups; ops `= != > >= < <= like !like starts ends matches in not in between`, `= null` / `!= null` for empty; values: numbers, "strings", true/false/null, ISO dates, relative spans `-1w 2d now`. Examples: `age > 30 and sex = "F"`; `created > -1w and (status in ("Open", "Blocked") or owner = @current)`; `mw between 200 and 500`. Prefer `u2-filter-builder` for visible criteria rows; this control for a one-line search box.

props.name: name
props.description: Stable key for forms and dumps; defaults to the label.

props.name: inline
props.description: Compact one-row variant without a label.

props.name: postfix
props.description: Units or a short suffix shown after the editor.

props.name: enabled
props.description: false grays the input out and blocks edits.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the value, selectable, but blocks edits.

props.name: required
props.description: An empty value is invalid once the input was edited, left or its form validated.

props.name: schema
props.description: `{properties: IProperty[], values?: {<name>: scalar[]}}` — what can be filtered on.

props.name: target
props.description: What the tree must be expressible for; validation only.

props.name: query
props.description: The draft text (per keystroke, may be unparsable; read-only).

props.name: visible
props.description: false hides the node; true by default.

components.description: A value the form owns: one writable signal several controls share.
components.usage: For a draft, a flag or a selection that outlives no single control — anything two nodes must agree on. Data that comes from somewhere belongs in a source, not here.

props.name: type
props.description: What the value holds; `initial` is checked against it.

props.name: initial
props.description: The value it starts at, and what `clear` returns it to; the type's empty value otherwise.

components.description: A function, query or script run as data: its outputs are what the form binds to.
components.usage: The default source for anything computed or queried. Bind a param to an input and the source re-runs as that input changes; bind a DataFrame output's `currentRow` to reach the fields of the current record.

props.name: func
props.description: The function name, `Package:Name` for a package function.

props.name: params
props.description: What it is called with; a `params.<name>` bind makes that param reactive.

props.name: auto
props.description: Run at construction and whenever a bound param changes (default true).

props.name: debounce
props.description: Milliseconds a param change waits before the re-run (default 300).

props.name: designData
props.description: What the designer shows: real runs, the declared shape without running, or the stored `sample`.

props.name: sample
props.description: The preview the `sample` policy builds its outputs from; rows become a table.

components.description: A paged listing of a server collection: users, groups, projects and the rest.
components.usage: For a picker over server entities, or a list of them. `names` feeds a choice input directly; `items` carries the entities themselves.

props.name: entity
props.description: The `grok.dapi` collection to list.

props.name: filter
props.description: A smart-search filter; changing it reloads the collection from the first page.

props.name: order
props.description: The field to order by.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: How many entities one page loads (default 20).

components.description: An open workspace table, by name — the whole DataFrame binding surface.
components.usage: For a form over a table the user already has open. It references the table BY NAME, so prefer a query or a project table for a form that must keep working tomorrow.

props.name: table
props.description: The name of the open table.

components.description: One server entity, looked up by id — the object a details form shows.
components.usage: For a form about a single entity. Bind `id` to whatever selects it and every bound field follows; the entity's own properties are binding steps.

props.name: entityType
props.description: Which collection the id belongs to.

props.name: id
props.description: The entity id to look up.

props.name: designData
props.description: What the designer shows: real runs, the declared shape without running, or the stored `sample`.

props.name: sample
props.description: The preview the `sample` policy builds its outputs from; rows become a table.
